name: Check balance
description: The caller asks for the balance of one of their accounts (checking or savings).

gate.question: Is this a balance-check call: does the caller want to know the balance of one of their accounts?

fields.model_hint: The account whose balance the caller wants.
The balance the AGENT tells the caller, as a number.

system_record.note: In HarperValleyBank this is tasks['account balance'] (the agent states it in 181 of 203 calls). In production use the bank's own system. Never show it to the model.

steps.name: Greet and open
steps.description: State the bank name and your own name, then ask how you can help.
steps.example_phrase: Hello, this is Harper Valley National Bank, my name is Jennifer. How can I help you today?
steps.done_when: The agent names the bank and gives their own name, then asks how they can help.

steps.name: Get account type
steps.description: Get which account the caller wants to check (checking or savings), by asking or by confirming.
steps.example_phrase: Which account would you like to check?
steps.done_when: The agent has the account type from the caller: asked for it, or confirmed it after the caller gave it.

steps.name: Log the balance check
steps.description: Log the task type and the account the caller asked about.

sub_checks.description: The agent logged the task type 'check balance'
The logged account type matches what the caller asked

steps.done_when: The agent logged the right task type and account type.

steps.name: State account balance
steps.description: Tell the caller the correct balance of the account they asked about.

sub_checks.description: The balance the agent stated matches the bank's record

steps.done_when: The agent states the balance, and it equals the bank's record.

steps.name: Offer further help
steps.description: Ask whether the caller needs anything else.
steps.example_phrase: Is there anything else I can help you with?
steps.done_when: The agent asks whether the caller needs anything else.

steps.name: Close
steps.description: Thank the caller and end the call.
steps.example_phrase: Thank you for calling, you have a great day.
steps.done_when: The agent thanks the caller or says goodbye before the call ends.
